The school garden has become an important part of daily life. There are always more possibilities than we expect. Anna has practiced tennis for three years and won a prize last term. He drank tea to stave off hunger.

Anna plans to study art harder this term. On Sunday evenings, Anna reviews the notes from class. Anna thanked Leo for the honest advice. What's more, he tasted chang, a traditional barley brew, in the mountain village.
The experience taught Anna more than any book could. Anna wrote down every idea in a small notebook. Anna believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. The lab demos run on open day.
